quebec-city.overview: Quebec City and Montreal offer accessible day hikes that trade deep wilderness for forested hills and glacial valleys just outside the urban centers. Near Quebec City, Parc national de la Jacques-Cartier provides steep climbs like the Les Loups trail, rewarding hikers with sweeping views of a deep river valley. Montreal's Mount Royal offers easy, graded paths right in the city. The best walking aligns with the vibrant fall foliage.

months.2: Snowshoeing is at its peak on the packed winter trails, offering a frosty walk through the bare hardwood forests.
months.8: Late summer offers excellent, reliable trail conditions across the provincial parks, with lush canopies shading the forest loops.
months.11: A transition month with bare trees, cold winds, and often icy trails before the snowpack is deep enough for snowshoes.

queenstown.overview: Queenstown is a base for exploring the Southern Alps on foot, offering everything from steep day hikes to multi-day alpine routes. The long, steep hike up Ben Lomond begins with a gondola ride to skip the lower slopes, rewarding walkers with panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu and the surrounding peaks. Trekkers come for the Routeburn Track, a 20-mile alpine crossing, and the Kepler Track, both requiring advance hut bookings. The best conditions run from December through March, when the high passes are clear of snow.

months.2: Excellent weather continues, making this an ideal time for long days in the mountains. High alpine routes like the Routeburn Track and Roys Peak near Wānaka are in peak condition, with long daylight hours to tackle the steep climbs.
months.10: The snow line begins to retreat, opening up mid-elevation trails. The high passes on the multi-day tracks are still snowbound, but lower day hikes become much more accessible.
months.11: The Great Walk season officially opens, with huts staffed and the major treks accessible again. Some snow may still linger on the highest passes of the Routeburn, but the Ben Lomond and Roys Peak day hikes are typically clear and ready for walkers.

rajaampat.overview: Raja Ampat is famous for its water, but visitors can find short walks on the islands. The best-known routes are the wooden stairs climbing to the karst viewpoints at Piaynemo and Wayag. Short jungle trails on Waigeo lead to bird viewing areas. Access requires a boat.

months.1: Calm seas make it easy to reach the island trailheads by boat. The short climbs to the Wayag and Piaynemo viewpoints look out over the karst islands.
months.2: Seas stay calm, so boat trips to the viewpoints at Wayag and Piaynemo run smoothly. The wooden stairs are a short, steady climb.
months.3: Calm conditions continue, and the boat ride to the island trailheads is easy. The short stair climbs reward with views over the karst.
months.4: Boat access is still mostly dependable for the short stair climbs to the Wayag and Piaynemo viewpoints.
months.6: The southeast monsoon brings rougher seas and rain, so boat trips to the trailheads can be difficult. The wooden stairs may be slippery.
months.7: Rougher seas and rain continue under the southeast monsoon, and wet wooden stairs to the viewpoints are slippery.
months.8: The monsoon holds, with rough water on some crossings and rain-slicked stairs at the karst viewpoints.
months.11: Calm seas return, making boat trips to the island trailheads easy again. The short climbs to the viewpoints open up views of the karst islands.
months.12: Calm seas and settled weather make boat access easy. The short climbs to Wayag and Piaynemo offer clear views over the karst islands.

rajasthan-golden-triangle.overview: Rajasthan's walking is limited to a few short day walks in the Aravalli Range. Rugged trails lead to viewpoints around Jaipur's Nahargarh Fort and along the walls of Kumbhalgarh, away from the cities.

months.1: Cool, dry weather suits short walks in the Aravalli hills. Trails around Jaipur and Kumbhalgarh are clear and comfortable.
months.2: Cool mornings and mild afternoons keep the short trails around Nahargarh Fort and Kumbhalgarh comfortable.
months.12: Cool, dry days return, making this a good month for short walks in the Aravalli hills around Jaipur and Kumbhalgarh.
months.5: Brutal heat makes walking on the exposed hillsides dangerous.
months.6: Extreme heat lingers until the monsoon arrives, and the exposed hillsides are unsafe to walk.

redwood.overview: Redwood National and State Parks offer day hiking through ancient old-growth forests and along rugged Pacific coastlines. The signature routes wind beneath towering canopies, like the ten-mile James Irvine Trail or the easier walks in Prairie Creek. Walking here is a year-round pursuit, with dry summer months providing the clearest conditions and winter bringing heavy rain that turns the forest floor vibrant green.

months.1: Heavy winter rains soak the coast, leaving the trails muddy but transforming the old-growth forest into a vibrant, lush green landscape.
months.4: Drier days become more common, making this a great time to tackle the James Irvine Trail.

rio.overview: Rio de Janeiro has rugged day hikes within the city limits, climbing through Atlantic Forest to viewpoints over the beaches and bays. The trails are steep and often involve scrambling, and a guide is advised for the exposed rock section of Pedra da Gávea. Dois Irmãos and Pico da Tijuca are shorter steep climbs with sweeping coastal panoramas.

months.2: The heat and humidity remain intense, making the steep climbs demanding. Early starts are essential, and afternoon rain can leave the forest trails slick.
months.7: Cool, dry conditions continue, offering the best weather for tackling the steep hike up Pedra da Gávea or the trail up Dois Irmãos.
